title: Gideon and the Songbook
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Ivo Lockridge, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
